```artifact
Feature: Virtual Health Platform

  Scenario: Admin can edit labs/pharmacy details
    Given the admin is logged in
    And the lab/pharmacy details page is open
    When the admin clicks the edit button
    And the admin updates the details
    Then the lab/pharmacy details are updated successfully

  Scenario: Patient can register
    Given the patient is not registered
    And the registration page is open
    When the patient fills in the registration form
    And the patient submits the form
    Then the patient is registered successfully

  Scenario: Patient can update profile
    Given the patient is logged in
    And the patient's profile page is open
    When the patient updates their profile information
    And the patient submits the changes
    Then the patient's profile is updated successfully

  Scenario: Patient can make appointments and submit online consultation requests
    Given the patient is logged in
    And the appointment/consultation page is open
    When the patient selects a doctor and time
    And the patient submits the appointment/consultation request
    Then the appointment/consultation is scheduled successfully

  Scenario: Patient can view and generate prescription reports and invoices
    Given the patient is logged in
    And the prescription/report page is open
    When the patient selects a date range
    And the patient generates the report
    Then the report is generated successfully

  Scenario: Doctor can provide consultation
    Given the doctor is logged in
    And the consultation page is open
    When the doctor provides the consultation
    And the doctor submits the consultation
    Then the consultation is recorded successfully

  Scenario: Doctor can prescribe medicine
    Given the doctor is logged in
    And the prescription page is open
    When the doctor selects a patient and medication
    And the doctor submits the prescription
    Then the prescription is generated successfully

  Scenario: Doctor can prescribe lab tests
    Given the doctor is logged in
    And the prescription page is open
    When the doctor selects a patient and lab test
    And the doctor submits the prescription
    Then the lab test is ordered successfully

  Scenario Outline: Admin can edit labs/pharmacy details with different types of updates
    Given the admin is logged in
    And the lab/pharmacy details page is open
    When the admin updates the details with <update_type>
    Then the lab/pharmacy details are updated successfully

    Examples:
      | update_type    |
      | name change    |
      | address change |
      | phone number change |
      | email change    |

  Scenario Outline: Patient can register with different types of information
    Given the patient is not registered
    And the registration page is open
    When the patient fills in the registration form with <registration_type>
    And the patient submits the form
    Then the patient is registered successfully

    Examples:
      | registration_type |
      | valid email       |
      | invalid email     |
      | valid phone number |
      | invalid phone number |

  Scenario Outline: Patient can update profile with different types of information
    Given the patient is logged in
    And the patient's profile page is open
    When the patient updates their profile information with <update_type>
    And the patient submits the changes
    Then the patient's profile is updated successfully

    Examples:
      | update_type    |
      | name change    |
      | address change |
      | phone number change |
      | email change    |

  Scenario Outline: Patient can make appointments and submit online consultation requests with different types of requests
    Given the patient is logged in
    And the appointment/consultation page is open
    When the patient selects a doctor and time with <request_type>
    And the patient submits the appointment/consultation request
    Then the appointment/consultation is scheduled successfully

    Examples:
      | request_type |
      | appointment  |
      | consultation  |
      | invalid request |

  Scenario Outline: Patient can view and generate prescription reports and invoices with different date ranges
    Given the patient is logged in
    And the prescription/report page is open
    When the patient selects a date range with <date_range>
    And the patient generates the report
    Then the report is generated successfully

    Examples:
      | date_range    |
      | today         |
      | yesterday     |
      | last week     |
      | invalid date range |

  Scenario Outline: Doctor can provide consultation with different types of consultations
    Given the doctor is logged in
    And the consultation page is open
    When the doctor provides the consultation with <consultation_type>
    And the doctor submits the consultation
    Then the consultation is recorded successfully

    Examples:
      | consultation_type |
      | video call       |
      | phone call       |
      | in-person visit  |
      | invalid consultation |

  Scenario Outline: Doctor can prescribe medicine with different types of medications
    Given the doctor is logged in
    And the prescription page is open
    When the doctor selects a patient and medication with <medication_type>
    And the doctor submits the prescription
    Then the prescription is generated successfully

    Examples:
      | medication_type |
      | valid medication |
      | invalid medication |
      | expired medication |

  Scenario Outline: Doctor can prescribe lab tests with different types of lab tests
    Given the doctor is logged in
    And the prescription page is open
    When the doctor selects a patient and lab test with <lab_test_type>
    And the doctor submits the prescription
    Then the lab test is ordered successfully

    Examples:
      | lab_test_type |
      | valid lab test |
      | invalid lab test |
      | expired lab test |

```
